bbs-b2b-pricing: Pull account-specific Grainger pricing for Black Box Safety through the b2b.blackboxsafety.com punch-out — the authorized path for Grainger pricing at BBS, always preferred over open-web Grainger searches. Use when a rep wants unit prices for Grainger part numbers under a BBS facility account, is filling the Unit Price column of an RFQ or NASPO line-item worksheet, or says "price these items", "run this through the punch-out", or "pull the B2B pricing". The input is a list of part numbers that already exists. Do NOT use to produce that list from a cart PDF, screenshot or DWR RFQ (use grainger-cart-info, grainger-screenshot, dwr-pdf-info first), or to check DGS BPO eligibility (use dgs-bpo-item- check). If a rep says only "check these Grainger items" without naming price or an account, ask whether they mean pricing or BPO eligibility before opening the punch-out.
bbs-quote-builder: Build a Black Box Safety, Inc. (BBS) sales quote on company letterhead in the standard SQ-104032 format and deliver it as a PDF. Use this skill whenever a BBS rep wants to turn a source document — a vendor cart PDF (Office Depot, Staples, Amazon), an RFQ spreadsheet, a customer item list, or pasted SKUs and quantities — into a formatted, customer-ready price quote. Trigger on requests like "make a quote," "build a BBS quote," "quote these items," "put this on our letterhead," "create a sales quote," "turn this cart into a quote," or any time a rep hands over items/prices and wants the branded BBS quote document. Always use this skill for BBS customer-facing quotes so numbering, the 900001-series format, the margin/markup math, and the letterhead layout stay uniform across the company. Do NOT use this skill to pull existing quote records out of Business Central (this skill builds the document from source data), and do NOT use it for internal vendor sourcing emails (use bbs-sourcing for that).
bbs-sourcing: Source pricing from vendors for a competitive bid RFQ at Black Box Safety. Use this skill whenever a BBS sales rep needs to turn an inbound competitive RFQ from a California state agency into vendor outreach — including when they say "source this RFQ," "get me pricing on these items," "reach out to vendors for this bid," "help me quote this," or paste/upload an RFQ worksheet and ask what to do next. Also use when the rep wants to follow up with non-responding vendors or leverage one vendor's quote against another's. Always use this skill for competitive, SB/DVBE, or Fair-and-Reasonable bids. DO NOT use when the RFQ is NASPO-routed or every item is available on grainger.com — those go through Provision Connect instead. Output is a sourcing brief plus vendor emails drafted in BBS's voice, rendered inline with pop-out buttons for Outlook.
ca-form-filler: Use this skill whenever a Black Box Safety sales rep needs to fill out California state compliance forms for a bid or RFQ response. Triggers include: any mention of "state forms", "bid packet", "compliance forms", "STD 204", "STD 205", "DGS PD 843", "CV 012", "DGS PD 1", "STD 1000", "CalRecycle 74", "form packet", "fill out the forms", "bid submission forms", or any upload of a PDF that appears to contain blank California state government forms. Also trigger when the rep says "I need to respond to this RFQ" alongside a form packet upload. The skill reads the vendor profile, extracts RFQ-specific data from the uploaded documents, maps all fields across all required forms, fills what can be pre-filled, flags all signature lines, and produces filled PDFs ready for rep review and submission.
ca-rfq-intake: Log an inbound California state quote request into the right customer folder and open its run record — the first move on any state RFQ, NASPO or competitive. Use this the moment a request arrives from a CDCR institution, CalVet home, DSH hospital, Caltrans district, CalFire unit, CMD, DWR, or any State of California agency, whether it comes as an email with attachments, a bare item list, a Line-Item Cost Worksheet, or a portal link — and use it before pricing anything, because an RFQ that never got logged is the one that misses its deadline. Also use it when asked to file, log, intake, or "start" a state quote request, or to find where a request should live.
dgs-bpo-item-check: Determine whether Grainger part numbers are approved for purchase under California's active DGS Blanket Purchase Order by looking each one up in the bundled BPO master item list (2025-2026 pricing). Use whenever a rep asks to check, verify, confirm, or cross-reference Grainger part numbers against the BPO, the DGS blanket purchase order, or the BPO list — "is this on the BPO", "BPO check", "are these approved". Answers on-list or off-list from the bundled file only; never from memory and never a guess. Do NOT use to obtain a price (use bbs-b2b-pricing) or to extract item numbers from a PDF, cart or screenshot. If a rep says only "check these Grainger items" without making clear whether they mean BPO eligibility or price, ask which before running.
dwr-pdf-info: Extract line items and quantities from a California Department of Water Resources Request for Quotation PDF — spoken of as DWR, a DWR RFQ, a DWR quote request, or simply "the DWR PDF" — including scanned or image-based ones. Use whenever a rep supplies a DWR RFQ PDF and wants the items and quantities, in one of three modes: Grainger, Sourcing, or Mixed. If the rep does not name a mode, ask; never guess it. Do NOT use for a Grainger cart PDF (use grainger-cart-info), a Grainger screenshot (use grainger-screenshot), an RFQ from an agency other than DWR, DGS BPO eligibility checks (use dgs-bpo-item-check), or pricing (use bbs-b2b-pricing).
grainger-cart-info: Extract Grainger item numbers and quantities from a saved or printed Grainger shopping-cart PDF and return them as ITEM#,QTY lines ready to paste into the BBS Grainger purchasing portal. Use when a customer or rep supplies a cart exported from grainger.com as a PDF and wants the line items pulled out. Always output the concatenated ITEM#,QTY format, never a table or prose. Do NOT use for a Grainger cart shared as a screenshot or image (use grainger-screenshot), a DWR Request for Quotation PDF (use dwr-pdf-info), any other agency RFQ or worksheet PDF, checking whether items are on the DGS BPO (use dgs-bpo-item-check), or pricing items (use bbs-b2b-pricing). This skill reads Grainger cart PDFs only. If the PDF is not a Grainger cart, say so rather than extracting from it anyway.
grainger-promo-page: Build a Black Box Safety product promotion landing page for a California public agency from a Grainger negotiated hot list or price sheet, with live pricing, product photography, a quote builder, SCPRS-sized buyer segments, and the brand compliance gate. Use this skill whenever a Grainger rep sends a priced sheet or hot list for an agency, whenever someone asks for a promo page, contract sheet, product landing page, punchout promo, or campaign page for CAL FIRE, CDCR, DWR, CHP, Caltrans, CalVet, a CSU or UC campus, or any other California agency, and whenever someone says they want to promote Grainger items or a hot list to an agency by email or web. Also use it when asked to price a list of Grainger item numbers for an agency account, or to segment an agency's buyers for a campaign.
grainger-screenshot: Extract part numbers and quantities from a screenshot or image of a Grainger page — a cart, order or item table shared as PNG, JPG or similar. Use when Grainger items arrive as a picture rather than as a PDF or text and the rep wants them pulled out. Always output [Part Number or Grainger Item #],[QTY] lines, never a table or prose. Do NOT use for a Grainger cart saved as a PDF (use grainger-cart-info), a DWR Request for Quotation PDF (use dwr-pdf- info), checking DGS BPO eligibility (use dgs-bpo-item-check), or pricing items (use bbs-b2b-pricing).
naspo-quote: Produce the full response to a California state agency RFQ routed under NASPO ValuePoint: pull live Grainger pricing for the requested item numbers, build the BBS sales quote PDF, and fill and sign the CA compliance packet (OBS Line-Item Cost Worksheet, CalRecycle 74, DGS PD 843, Darfur OBS 1500, OBS 1000 GenAI, Bidder Declaration GSPD-05-105). Use when a CDCR institution, CalVet home, CSU/UC campus, Caltrans district or any State of California agency asks for pricing on Grainger item numbers, sends blank state certs to complete, or both — even if they never say NASPO, and even if the ask looks like only pricing or only paperwork, because on state business the two halves ship together. Do NOT use to file or log a request that just arrived (ca-rfq-intake does that first), for a competitive SB/DVBE bid needing vendor sourcing (use bbs-sourcing), or for the CDCR OBS 4007(B) Packet-B (use obs-form- filler).
obs-form-filler: Fill out the CDCR OBS 4007(B) "RFQ Packet-B" California state compliance forms for Black Box Safety (BBS). Use this skill whenever a BBS rep needs to respond to a CDCR (Department of Corrections and Rehabilitation) informal competitive RFQ — i.e. whenever they upload or mention a blank OBS 4007(B) packet, "Packet B", "OBS 4007", a CDCR RFQ, or ask to fill out the bid forms / compliance packet for a CDCR quote. Also trigger when a rep provides a quote (product, price, quantity) plus a solicitation number and asks to "fill the OBS form", "redo this on the new forms", "complete the bid packet", or "fill out the CDCR forms". The rep supplies the quote line items, the dates, the agency contact info, and their own rep info (name/title/email); this skill merges in BBS's fixed vendor profile, fills all 9 sub-forms, embeds signatures, and produces a submission-ready PDF. Do NOT use for non-CDCR bid packets, NASPO/Grainger-routed quotes, or generic California state forms unrelated to the OBS 4007(B) packet.
vendor-quote-email: Generates a vendor pricing quote request email for a Black Box Safety, Inc. sales rep. Use this skill whenever the user asks to draft a vendor quote email, pricing request, or wants to email a vendor/supplier for pricing. Trigger phrases include: "draft a quote email", "vendor quote", "pricing request email", "email a vendor for pricing", "quote request", "create a quote email", or any request to contact a vendor/supplier for item pricing on behalf of a customer agency. Always render the interactive form widget — never draft this email as free-form text without showing the form first.
bbs-deck-voice: Generate customer-facing PowerPoint slide copy in Parker Marshall's voice for Black Box Safety (BBS) federal pursuits (SDVOSB / GSA Schedule / set-asides). Use this skill whenever Parker needs slide headlines, sub-bullets, speaker notes, or full-deck copy for a federal customer or teaming presentation, or says "write the deck copy," "put this on slides," "slide headlines for the [agency] deck," "capability briefing," "make this slide-ready," or hands over raw content and asks for presentation-ready wording. This is the authorized voice standard for BBS federal decks. Always use it so certification discipline (SDVOSB, never DVBE in federal context), federal-traction honesty, and Parker's no-filler, no-em-dash style stay uniform. Do NOT use for CA state agency decks (that context uses DVBE), for email drafts (Parker's email voice lives elsewhere), or for building the .pptx file itself (use the pptx skill for assembly; this skill produces the words).
